title: Change priority of all processes for a user
summary: Adjust the CPU priority for all processes currently running under a specific user account.

steps.explain: Use the -u flag to target all processes owned by a specific user ID or username.

placeholders.name: NICENESS_VALUE
placeholders.description: The new priority level, from -20 (highest) to 19 (lowest).

placeholders.name: USER_ID_OR_NAME
placeholders.description: The username or user ID whose processes should be modified.

rollback.explain: To revert, set the niceness back to 0 for that user.

warnings: This affects all current processes for that user. New processes will start with default priority.
Requires root privileges to change priorities for other users.
